svg.data-weight-note: 7.25 lb (3.29 kg); the EX2300-24T-DC 7.83 lb (3.55 kg), Table 3
svg.data-power-input: 100 through 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz; the -DC part number -48 through -60 VDC
svg.data-power-current-max: 2.5 A at 100 VAC; 1.25 A at 240 VAC; -DC 2.8 A
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: hardware guide, Uplink Ports: the four uplink ports take SFP and SFP+ transceivers. A Virtual Chassis can be formed with SFP+ and not with SFP
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to four switches; the -VC part number ships with the Virtual Chassis licence on paper, the other part numbers do not
